zh.what: 可观测性开放标准 OpenTelemetry 的 Python 接口：在代码里记录调用链路、指标等数据，供监控系统分析。
zh.before: 各监控厂商有各自的埋点库，换厂商就要改代码。

roles.dev: 配置控制台输出，给一个函数加上追踪片段（span）看耗时。
roles.pm: 让大模型调用的延迟、错误和用量可追踪，便于排查问题。
roles.qa: 关注未配置 SDK 时数据不上报，以及异步调用中追踪信息丢失。
roles.algo: 用于监控推理服务和智能体调用链，不参与模型计算。

en.what: The Python API of the OpenTelemetry observability standard: record traces, metrics and similar data in code for monitoring systems to analyse.
en.before: Each monitoring vendor had its own instrumentation library, so switching vendors meant rewriting code.

roles.dev: Install the SDK with a console exporter, wrap a function in a span and view its timing.
roles.pm: Makes latency, errors and usage of LLM calls traceable, easing troubleshooting.
roles.qa: Watch data not exported when no SDK is configured, and trace context lost across async calls.
roles.algo: Monitors inference services and agent call chains; not part of model computation.

roles.dev: 用 trace.getTracer 创建 span，包住一段函数调用。

en.what: The public API package of OpenTelemetry, letting code emit tracing, metrics and other observability data in one standard way.
en.before: Monitoring vendors' SDKs were incompatible, so switching platforms meant rewriting instrumentation code.

roles.dev: Get a tracer with trace.getTracer and wrap a function call in a span.
roles.pm: Makes request flows and LLM call latency traceable and measurable for troubleshooting.
roles.qa: Watch data silently dropped when no SDK is registered, and context lost across async code.
roles.algo: Can trace LLM calls and inference requests; not involved in model computation.
